note: One primary cause per sampled failure (seed 0, 30 of 150), assigned by reading the question, the labelled relevant answers (first 700 characters) and the top 3 results (first 400 characters). One reader, one pass. Causes overlap in places; the note gives the reason for the choice. Queries are question titles only, so 'answer depends on the question body' is inferred from the answer referring to details the title does not contain.

causes.body: Labelled answer responds to details in the full question post, which the query (title only) does not contain
causes.unlabelled: Top results are reasonable answers to the query but are not labelled relevant (labels cover only the answers posted under that question)
causes.aspect: Top results are on the right topic but miss the specific point asked
causes.vocabulary: Labelled answer gives the advice without using the question's key terms
causes.fusion: BM25 alone ranked a relevant answer in the top 3, dense missed it, and the 0.8 dense weight buried it
